CHAPTER.VERS: For the time past may suffice to have worked the desire of the Gentiles, and to have walked in sexual immorality, erotic desires, winebibbings, revelings, carousings, and horrible idolatries:
who will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
For to this end was the good news preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
using hospitality one to another without murmuring:
according to as each has received a gift, serving [with] it among yourselves, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God;

if any man speaks, [speaking] as it were oracles of God; if any man serves, [serving] as of the strength which God supplies: that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, whose is the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
but if [a man suffers] as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this name.
For the time [has come] for judgment to begin at the house of God: and if [it begins] first at us, what [will be] the end of those who do not obey the good news of God?
And if the righteous is scarcely saved, where will the ungodly and sinner appear?
Therefore let them also that suffer according to the will of God commit their souls in well-doing to a faithful Creator.
